scientific_integrity: Proof by forced path concatenations, labelled cycle insertion, and one-vertex construction. Finite checking supports but cannot certify all parameters. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Single partial injection and odd order only; not a multi-generator odd-EPPA theorem. Pre-existing odd-cycle totals c_a are classical; the extension-profile and minimality synthesis may have older equivalents. Exhaustive computation was bounded to small labelled sets.
title: Optimal odd-order completions of finite partial permutations
